title: sources/index.json — every fetched source
description: One record per source. A source counts only when its text is saved at `file` (sourcing.md §1). Several sources from one publisher count as ONE independent source.

id.description: Short stable id used by claims and events, e.g. "s7" or "0007".

publisher.description: Who published it — the unit of independence ("HistoryLink", "Seattle Times", "National Park Service").

date.description: The source's own date (ISO, or a year).

ownWords.description: The subject's own words: a letter, testimony, an oral history.

ownWordsSpan.description: Which part is theirs: "all" (a letter, an oral history), or {from, to} with their first and last words (a signed article on a newspaper page). Unmarked, only the passages naming them count as words.
